name: W. F. Steele
bio: Col. W. F. Steele of Kidder County was nominated for the house at a legislative convention reported in October 1884, and in October 1886 was the Republican nominee for the legislature from Kidder County, visiting Medora to look after his campaign; the paper said he represented the 'bull-dozing qualities' of the ticket. In the November 1886 returns, the Democrat Greene was reported to have a majority of 500 over him.
